examples.en: The man is drinking a coffee.
The woman is eating an apple.

examples.fr: Je mange du pain le matin.
examples.en: I eat bread in the morning.
The fish is in the water.
The taxi is going to the airport.
I am going to the hotel.
I am looking at the map.
The train station is on the left.
The hotel is on the right.

examples.fr: Je donne un cadeau à ma mère.
examples.en: I am giving a gift to my mother.

examples.fr: Le patron arrive à huit heures.
examples.en: The boss arrives at eight o'clock.

examples.fr: Le papier est sur la table.
examples.en: The paper is on the table.
I am going to the market.

examples.fr: Il y a une solution simple.
Nous allons dans la bonne direction.
examples.en: We are going in the right direction.

examples.fr: C'est la réalité, pas un rêve.
examples.en: It is reality, not a dream.

examples.fr: Elle écoute de la musique le soir.
examples.en: She listens to music in the evening.
I do not have enough money.

examples.fr: La librairie vend des livres neufs.
J'emprunte un livre à la bibliothèque.
examples.en: I borrow a book from the library.

examples.fr: Tu as de la monnaie pour le bus ?
examples.en: Do you have change for the bus?

examples.fr: Je préfère rester à la maison.
examples.en: I prefer to stay at home.
We are waiting for the train.
